name: Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends bugs of the original Alchemy and leaves the game as it was: its rules, scores, sounds and pace. Each fix is a toggle; turn the whole mod off to play the original exactly as it was.

settings.label: Tile rims on the first column and row
settings.help: A lit tile has a soft rim where it borders an unlit one. The original leaves it off on the first column and row. Shows from the next board.

settings.label: A continued game ends in place
settings.help: When a saved game that you continued is lost, its pieces shrink away on their tiles. The original draws them off the board, so they vanish at once.
